title: UMW SS32B through SS320B SMB Schottky Rectifier datasheet
note: BOM D2 says UMW SS34, LCSC C2758511, SMB. LCSC exact stock-code datasheet is the SS32B-SS320B family, whose SMB order code is SS34B.
